Workbench initializes spare Vec capacity before using it and restores the
original length if the codec unwinds. The Miniz compatibility methods for
MaybeUninit output stage bytes in an initialized buffer. The Rust wrapper
forbids unsafe code when an optional C backend is absent. Miniz uses its
portable Adler-32 path unless another consumer explicitly enables SIMD.
